`synthetic.xpt` is a five-row synthetic SAS XPORT V5 file generated with pyreadstat 1.3.7. Columns: ID=1..5, VALUE=[12.5,0,missing,88,99], LABEL=[alpha,beta,gamma,delta,epsilon]. It contains no BRFSS records and no research outcomes. The actual pandas XPT parser is exercised on this fixture both directly and inside temporary ZIP archives. pyreadstat is not required to run the tests.
